Alu Kurumba korevu, Badaga koruva/goruvo and Kota kʰaru are comparative cold-family responses preserving source voicing, aspiration and final vowels; uncertain Toda song/contact variants are excluded. This is a comparative family proposal; inheritance versus local transmission in this survey lect remains subject to review.
